name: gap_fill_full_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, overnight gaps of 0.3-1.0% create a marked divergence from the prior session's institutional benchmark levels. VWAP-benchmarked algorithms (mutual funds, FIIs executing large directional mandates) begin accumulating against the gap direction from the first bar, as they receive better-than-VWAP fills when NIFTY is below (gap down) or above (gap up) the intraday VWAP. The first cross of intraday VWAP — typically 15-45 minutes after open — signals that accumulated institutional pressure has overwhelmed retail gap-chasing flow, creating a directional impulse of 15-25 NIFTY spot points over the next 30-90 seconds as momentum followers pile in behind the institutional accumulation. At 5-second resolution we enter exactly at the VWAP cross bar.
core_signal_oneliner: Gap 0.3-1.0% day: first VWAP cross in the gap-fill direction within 09:20-10:30 IST, confirmed by RSI not at extreme
